name: save_test_card
title: File F5 SAVE AS writes a new project folder on the card in the unit (any SD card; --expect-volume is optional)

steps.note: a card is in the unit, not write protected, or nothing below runs

the project's own save job is through: a Save As of t-v16 (16 samples) takes about 100 s on the unit (v0.6.11: 106.9 s; 0.4.12: INSTR01 13 % at 1 s ... DONE at 103 s). The samples' SAVE_INSTRnn_DONE messages come first, one each, and end a looser wait while the save still runs (OS-HIL); a load or a save started meanwhile is refused ('a load or a save is already running'). The folder number NN is kept as {{SAVED}}. A save that never ends fails here
(the writer closes the project file after the last message)
the save ended DONE and nothing after it said otherwise
the project file is in the new folder, not empty
